MAIN IS RED at 71d04b3609 (the #2597 merge). Run 38557210178: 2 failures in bug_2004_token_leak_argv_tests.
Cause: a semantic merge conflict. #2599 added PATH-mutating tests; #2597's new guard requires PATH tests to run through run_path_isolated_test().
1. PAUSE merges until main is green. Any PR built on it now will inherit the red.
2. A Claude implementer (advisor-commissioned) is opening a fix PR: '[AI:claude] fix(tests): run BUG-2004 token tests under PATH isolation (BUG-1994)'. Review it FIRST with one fresh standard reviewer: test-only; check the assertions are unchanged and the token-in-argv mutation still fails. Merge on approve plus green. I commissioned it, so you merge it.
3. Then resume with #2598, #2611 and #2601.
subject: MAIN RED (#2597 x #2599): pause merges; fix PR incoming
